text:
rachel (Marketing): Drafting a compact Field Launch Kit one-pager for enterprise secure inference. Scope: 1-page exec brief, a single benchmark callout, a 30m webinar outline, and an inbound routing snippet we can hand to infra. Target publish: tomorrow AM. Quick review pls.

diego (Product): Nice. Add a 1-line on model-version pinning + automatic fallback to compatible variants. Also call out KMS/HSM support for Private deployments. Keep the SLA blurb short.

sana (Field): Benchmarks we should show (consumer-friendly): test profile = 150 concurrent clients, seq=384, model=redwood-enterprise-quant. Suggested numbers for collateral: Hosted: p50=130ms p99=410ms cost~$0.19/1k tokens. Dedicated: p50=40ms p99=70ms throughput~140 req/s/GPU cost~$0.045/1k tokens. Add a tiny note: "measurement: steady-state with auto-batching; results vary by model and seq length."

mira (Sales): Inbound routing: use tags = {segment:enterprise, interest:private, compliance:requires-audit}. Route enterprise+private -> queue.AE-Enterprise; if compliance present add queue.compliance and alert solutions. Capture expected peak qps and desired SLA on form. Also add "pilot timeline" field (e.g., <30 days).

sana (Field): Routing YAML for infra team:```yaml
routing_rules:
  - match: tags.segment == 'enterprise' && tags.interest == 'private'
    route_to: queue.AE-Enterprise
    priority: 85
  - match: tags.compliance == 'requires-audit'
    route_to: queue.compliance
    priority: 95
  - match: tags.pilot_timeline == '<30_days'
    route_to: queue.enterprise-rapid
    priority: 98
  - fallback: queue.SDR-inbound
```

diego (Product): SLA copy for the one-pager: "SLA: 99.95% monthly uptime for Dedicated plans. Latency SLOs published by deployment and model family; customers can request custom SLOs during onboarding. Automatic model-variant fallback and cross-region failover reduce outage risk."

rachel (Marketing): Webinar sketch (30m): 6m market framing (problem + Redwood thesis), 10m demo (deploy modes + console walkthrough), 10m benchmark deep-dive (method + numbers + caveats), 4m CTA/Q&A. CTA: "Request a private trial" + link to intake form. Mira will handle CTAs and Q&A.

mira (Sales): I'll draft the registration landing copy: "Field Launch Kit: Secure inference one-pager + live demo. See how teams meet enterprise SLAs, reduce inference costs, and deploy in VPCs or on-prem. Includes pilot availability." Adding required fields now.

sana (Field): Customer blurb we can use (two lines): "VertexHealth piloted Redwood Dedicated in a Private VPC and cut inference costs ~3x while maintaining 99.95% uptime. Pilot included dedicated GPUs, KMS integration, and full audit logs."

ops-bot: Assets uploaded: /assets/field-launch-kit/onepager-v1.pdf and /assets/field-launch-kit/webinar-landing.html. Docs reference: https://playbook.internal/field-launch-kit. Auto-schedule preliminary webinar slot for next Thu 10am PT (tentative).

rachel (Marketing): Two quick asks before publish v1: (1) @sana please confirm VertexHealth blurb is publishable, (2) @diego confirm Dedicated p99 and throughput numbers. If both green I'll finalize copy and push a short launch post + webinar invite. Thanks all! :rocket:
